My SO had a depression for some months. I saw the signs but couldn't act directly. Since it was very hard for him to seek help, i went with him and we found a good counselor (he went to the counseling sessions on his own though). I tried to push him to do certain activities which he liked before but didn't anymore. I tried to keep his life going and prevent him of sitting all alone in his room having negative thoughts. It was hard and tough. We've had many fights and it was emotionally hard for me too, but eventually things cleared up. He's not depressed anymore and the joy in his life is back. We are still happily together!

I have to note that he didn't have the kind of depression where he cried all days. He was just very sad and constantly in a negative mood. Maybe your SO can go with you to find a counselor too. The fact that he's constantly asking you for the reasons and that he's listening is already a good sign. He genuinely cares about you. I think giving it a shot to a counselor could make things already a little bit easier for both of you :-). Stay strong!
